proposition: New Brethren names Ulugh Beg as one of Ibn Turka's three Timurid patrons and Timurid-Mughal says Ibn Turka cultivated his patronage by dedicating a lettrist work to him. The dissertation pages read say only that a copy of the Sharḥ al-Basmala was sent to Ulugh Beg (timeline) and that a marginal dedication to him stands in MS Majlis 10196 f. 332b; it describes Qāżīzāda's letter of thanks but no patron relationship with Ulugh Beg.
